sections.description: Adds to GWND Fulfillment: more page styles and the full style builder (export/import, custom CSS), and 4×6 and bulk packing slips.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

Credited to Great White North Design, always.

Removed

  • The Branding tab (menu name, plugin name and author, credit line on/off, support note). GWND Fulfillment 1.2.2+ always shows the Great White North Design credit, naming Pro when it's active. Updating deletes any branding a store had saved (gwnfp_brand).

Changed

  • Plugin URI is now https://greatwhitenorthdesign.ca/tools/fulfillment/.
  • Docs say plainly: no ShipStation or other shipping-platform integration. The 1.2.0 cleanup that deletes old ShipStation and live-tracking settings stays.

1.2.0

First release of the Pro add-on.

Added

  • Styles Poster, Split, Banner, Receipt and Route, the style builder, custom CSS, and style export/import.
  • 4×6 packing slips and bulk printing; Branding tab for white-label.
  • Live tracking and ShipStation capture are not included for now: customers get a link to the carrier's own tracking page. Updating from a test build stops the old poller and deletes those saved settings (including carrier keys).
  • Signed updates for this add-on and, until it's on WordPress.org, for GWND Fulfillment.
